title: Atif Hussain (@atifhussainreal) on Threads
text:
In the demo, when a setup appeared, I entered immediately.

Zero hesitation. The FVG was there. The 4H direction was clear. I clicked.

On live, the exact same setup appeared and something changed.

My finger froze above the button.

Because now it was real money.

And suddenly "1% risk" FELT like losing $500.

I started skipping valid setups.

Not because I didn't see them. Because I was afraid of them.

title: Stephen Burns (@sjosephburns) on Threads
text:
Just For One Month Try This:

1.  Only one strategy.
2.  Take only carefully calculated risks.
3.  Journal all trades fully. 
4.  Focus on 1 or 2 quality trades per day.

Trust me, Your whole trading will change.

title: TraderLight (@traderlight_) on Threads
text:
Truth 3: Break of Structure requires a body close.

A wick past a level is often just a grab for liquidity.

If the candle body doesn't close past the previous high or low, then the trend hasn't fully shifted. 

Don't get fooled by fake-outs, wait for confirmation.
